rows.text: The Monetary Policy Committee of the Bank of Korea decided today to raise the benchmark call rate (uncollateralized overnight rate) by 25 basis points from 3.25% to 3.5% for the intermeeting period.
In a related action, the Committee raised the interest rates on Liquidity Adjustment Loans of the Bank of Korea by the same 25 basis points to 3.25%.
Meanwhile, the Committee maintained the interest rates on Aggregate Credit Ceiling Loans of the Bank of Korea at its current level(2.0%).
